nodes.text: $ZOE makes a heroic diving jump and catches Sam just before she hits the ground.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Whoa! Did you see that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice move, new girl... Are you here to try out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Would you `please` let go of me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Would you [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] let go of me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er... Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: No sweat. I'll show you around.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: For your first week, you'll have the option of 'shopping around' and looking at different classes.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That way you can decide what you like best.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Since you're trying to make the cheerleading team this week, I'd recommend heading to classes where you can hang out with the other cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: After all, if you can make friends with people, they'll be more likely to vote for you on Friday!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: If you really want to make the team this week, it's all about `managing your time` wisely.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you really want to make the team this week, it's all about [color=#e23b3b][i]managing your time[/i][/color] wisely.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Every day, you'll have two chances to hang out with people `in` school... And a two chances `after` school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Every day, you'll have two chances to hang out with people [color=#e23b3b][i]in[/i][/color] school... And a two chances [color=#e23b3b][i]after[/i][/color] school!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: As the week goes on, I'm sure you'll figure out which classes the other cheerleaders are taking...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: But for now, let me show you just a couple...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is the gym. `Nicole` and `Jill` hang out here.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is the gym. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nicole[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]Jill[/i][/color] hang out here.

nodes.text: New Class Added!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: They're the most intense athletes on the team, and they can train you on your moves!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is English. You can come here any time you want to hang out with `me.` Definitely a good time.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is English. You can come here any time you want to hang out with [color=#e23b3b][i]me.[/i][/color] Definitely a good time.

nodes.text: New Class Added!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And that pretty much completes our tour.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Just one more thing...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You're going to get to know a lot of different cheerleaders this week.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Just be aware that some are harder to win over than others...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And that Sam is going to be working just as hard as you to buddy up to the team!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: For example, she's taking `me` out to coffee later!
nodes.text_bbcode: For example, she's taking [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] out to coffee later!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Anyway... I'm sure you'll figure out the rest as you go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Sure thing... And don't forget to have fun. All work and no play is no way to go through life.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Whoa! I guess you're more on top of things than I gave you credit for!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, have fun today... I'm sure I'll see you around.
$ZOE tries to catch Sam, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! Sam landed right on top of her!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Good thing the new girl was there to break Sam's fall.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Embarrassing...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Oh no... You'd better get off of her, Sam... Her leg is bent all the way back!
Sam stands up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I'm fine. Don't worry about my leg... I'm pretty flexible from taking gymnastics back in middle school.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You took `gymnastics?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You took [color=#3b78e2][i]gymnastics?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa... You `have` to try out for the team. We could use someone like you for our stunts!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa... You [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to try out for the team. We could use someone like you for our stunts!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, I'd better get back to football practice. See you around.
Howard heads off into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I told you not to talk to him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just... Just stay away from me, okay? I'm going over there to try out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll just watch the tryouts...
A group of girls gathers nearby to try out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, girls, line up! It's time to start your tryout.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, as you may know, our good friend Amanda was injured during the tragic Winter Formal Snowball incident.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That means we need a midseason replacement...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which is where you all come in.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's time to show us your moves, girls... Whoever we like best becomes the newest member of the cheerleading team!
Two of the girls on the team walk up to Sam and start talking.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry about a thing, Samantha... You're `guaranteed` to get this spot.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry about a thing, Samantha... You're [color=#3b78e2][i]guaranteed[/i][/color] to get this spot.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We'll make sure the other cheerleaders vote for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hehe. Thanks, guys. But I should at least `pretend` to try out, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hehe. Thanks, guys. But I should at least [color=#3b78e2][i]pretend[/i][/color] to try out, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So `that's` how it is. Typical popular girl politics...
nodes.text_bbcode: So [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] how it is. Typical popular girl politics...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, girls... Let's start with some throws!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, Sam... Let's give this a shot. Hector and I are going to give you a toss. But don't worry, we'll catch you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I haven't let a girl get injured on my watch yet.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Er... Unless you count when I accidentally broke Amanda's leg at Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... Uh... That was completely different, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.
The guys get ready to throw Sam into the air.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! Careful where you're grabbing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm trying to get a good grip!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go grip yourself!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh... Guys? We gotta do this throw on the count of three...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: One... Two...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! I thought I warned you not to...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Three!
Keith tries to heave Sam into the air, but Hector lets go. She comes flying toward $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As much as I'd like to, I can't just let Sam fall... I've got to catch her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool. It's nice to have a new face around here...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks. Your face isn't so bad either.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I mean, you have a nice smile... Er... Wait...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'll have to pardon her... She's not used to talking to... People.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No worries... I remember how it was for me when I first got here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was super nervous.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But now I love it here... And I'm sure you will too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool! I never knew you had a cousin, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... You look upset. I didn't interrupt an important conversation or something, did I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, $ZOE here was just telling me about some... `Intestinal issues` she's having.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, $ZOE here was just telling me about some... [color=#3b78e2][i]Intestinal issues[/i][/color] she's having.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... I... See...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I hope you feel better, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Ohmygosh. `Howard` is coming this way! Don't say a `word!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Ohmygosh. [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard[/i][/color] is coming this way! Don't say a [color=#3b78e2][i]word![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. Who's your friend?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow... He's, like, completely gorgeous.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's true... I am kind of shy around guys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aw... Geez... Don't look at me like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I didn't mean to come off as a `complete` jerk...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I didn't mean to come off as a [color=#3b78e2][i]complete[/i][/color] jerk...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just... I just really, `really` want this spot on the cheerleading team.
nodes.text_bbcode: I just... I just really, [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want this spot on the cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I can't let anything... Or `anyone` get in my way.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I can't let anything... Or [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] get in my way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've had `lots` of boyfriends!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've had [color=#3b78e2][i]lots[/i][/color] of boyfriends!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Name one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... There was... Joe... `Field.` And, er... Bob... `Bleachers.` And Tim... `Goalpost!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... There was... Joe... [color=#3b78e2][i]Field.[/i][/color] And, er... Bob... [color=#3b78e2][i]Bleachers.[/i][/color] And Tim... [color=#3b78e2][i]Goalpost![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You just made up those names from looking around the football stadium, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow... You're an even bigger loser than I remember...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There you are... I can't believe it's been `5 years` already!
nodes.text_bbcode: There you are... I can't believe it's been [color=#e23b3b][i]5 years[/i][/color] already!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But don't worry, we're going to take good care of you until your parents get back from teaching in Europe!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: You know, I still think you look like your cousin Samantha... Something about the eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mom...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Now, don't be rude, dear. Come over here and hug your cousin.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh no thanks... Hey there... You.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Sam! You can at least address your cousin by her proper name!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's `great` to have you here again, Cousin Zoe...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] to have you here again, Cousin Zoe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's good to see you too...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was `so` much fun hanging out when we were little... I'm sure it'll be just like old times.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much fun hanging out when we were little... I'm sure it'll be just like old times.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's up with Sam? Is she holding an old grudge or something?

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Arf!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Oh... And it looks like Puddles still remembers you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, boy! I missed you too!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I'm also `sure` you're going to love Centerscore High.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm also [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] you're going to love Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: In fact, you're going to get your first taste of it today!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to an `emergency cheerleading tryout.` You can come and watch.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to an [color=#3b78e2][i]emergency cheerleading tryout.[/i][/color] You can come and watch.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Go ahead and put your bag in the hallway, dear. You can unpack later.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Emergency cheerleading tryout?'
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Okay, girls... I'm off to buy groceries for $ZOE's first meal with us tonight!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I'll see you soon!
Aunt Cathy drives away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew... Don't talk to me where other people might see, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The last thing I need is for my stupid cousin to ruin things right when I'm on the verge of becoming a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I don't...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, it's nothing personal. I just can't afford to be associated with some lame tomboy who nobody knows.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean... You know how it is, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's face it... You obviously don't know how to dress, and can barely speak without mumbling...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...And I can tell just by looking at you that you've never had a boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it `that` obvious?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] obvious?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's, uh... That's...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: That's, uh... That's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmm... What could I do by myself?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know! I'll hang out with Puddles!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Whimper.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's play 'Pony Farm'! I'll be the stable owner, and you can be my prized pony!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: But I don't want to be a pony...
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Watch out, Pony! The farm is being attacked by pillow monsters!
$ZOE throws a pillow at Puddles.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: That's it... I'm definitely peeing on her shoes tonight...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just because I'm all alone doesn't mean I can't have fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know! I'll watch T.V. That'll make me feel better!
Two hours later, $ZOE is watching the local news...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: ...police say that neighbors only found the body three weeks later when the smell began to permeate the neighborhood.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: As one local man explained, 'She never really went outside anyway. We figured she was just holed up in her room watching TV or something.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I need to get out more...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Alone again... What to do, what to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know! I'll come up with my own theme song!
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $ZOE is the coolest girl I `know!` Everyone says she should have her own `show!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE is the coolest girl I [color=#3b78e2][i]know![/i][/color] Everyone says she should have her own [color=#3b78e2][i]show![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $ZOE gets an 'A' on every `exam!` She's way hotter than her cousin `Sam!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE gets an 'A' on every [color=#3b78e2][i]exam![/i][/color] She's way hotter than her cousin [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Whimper...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you just cheer for me, boy?
Puddles shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `really` need to get out more. Even Puddles is turning against me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] need to get out more. Even Puddles is turning against me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't think of anything fun to do...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll just stare at the wall for the next two hours...
Two hours later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know... I have a really nice wall.
$ZOE effortlessly snags the ball out of the air and sends it flying back to Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! Are you sure you've never done this before? You throw better than some of the guys on the team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... If I get rejected from the cheerleading squad, I guess I can always try out for football.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, but you'll make the squad. I know you can do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, this is delicious. I'm glad you took me here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You looked like you needed to do something fun. Besides, this is the best dessert in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hah. I never would have thought the big, tough football star would have a soft spot for desserts.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I was only thinking of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just kidding. I appreciate it. Thanks for taking me here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem. I don't know why I was so weird about bringing you here sooner. I thought it might be awkward...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But with you, I always have a good time. I should have known better.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're really an amazing girl, $ZOE. You know that, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww... Thanks.
$ZOE's car speeds past Rachel's just as they reach the finish line!

nodes.speaker: Rachel
nodes.text: What?! I never lose!

nodes.speaker: Rachel
nodes.text: Oh no... I sounded like a total nerd just then!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. It's okay. This game is pretty fun.

nodes.speaker: Rachel
nodes.text: And it's nice to finally have an opponent that actually provides a challenge.

nodes.speaker: Rachel
nodes.text: Okay, $ZOE... Here's two more dollars in quarters. Rematch time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, it's really fun to geek-out with Rachel.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... I'll give it a shot.
An hour later, $ZOE gets a phone call from Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just wanted to report that your advice worked `great!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just wanted to report that your advice worked [color=#3b78e2][i]great![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It turns out, Phil basically just wanted to make out the whole time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Great.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway. Thanks for the help. I owe you one!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Score one for $ZOE!
An hour later, $ZOE gets a phone call from Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just wanted to `thank` you for giving me the worst advice `ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just wanted to [color=#3b78e2][i]thank[/i][/color] you for giving me the worst advice [color=#3b78e2][i]ever![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It turns out the Phil's latest interest is colon-cleansing diets!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Have you ever heard a hot guy talk about his bowel movements for forty minutes? `Well now I have!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Have you ever heard a hot guy talk about his bowel movements for forty minutes? [color=#3b78e2][i]Well now I have![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Next time I need advice, I guess I'll have to call `Amanda.` Shudder.
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time I need advice, I guess I'll have to call [color=#3b78e2][i]Amanda.[/i][/color] Shudder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor. It's $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! It's a good thing you called, I'm in the middle of a date with Phil, and I need some advice, ASAP!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There have been `so` many awkward silences... And I can't tell if it's a good thing or a bad thing!
nodes.text_bbcode: There have been [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] many awkward silences... And I can't tell if it's a good thing or a bad thing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like... Is he trying to build up the courage to make a move? Or is he just a quiet kind of guy?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Help! Say something! Give me advice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay. Next time there's an awkward silence...

nodes.prompt: Next time there's an awkward silence...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Next time there's an awkward silence...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor was just telling me about this baby rabbit she found in her back yard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Its mom had abandoned it, but Taylor put it in a shoebox and nursed it back to health.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wow... That's pretty amazing, Taylor. I didn't know you were so into animals.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Maybe we could go to the zoo sometime.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really?!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Sure. Here, why don't I get your number? I'll give you a call.
A few minutes later, Phil takes off to meet some friends.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE, you completely disobeyed orders and talked when I told you not to.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But, given the way things turned out, I'm willing to overlook this little transgression.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `definitely` just won some points with Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] just won some points with Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... I think I see some of my friends over... There.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I don't see...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Bye!
Phil runs away.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Look what you did!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you said not to talk.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't try to pin this on `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't try to pin this on [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I never should have asked a wing-`girl` to do a wing-`woman`'s job...
nodes.text_bbcode: I never should have asked a wing-[color=#3b78e2][i]girl[/i][/color] to do a wing-[color=#3b78e2][i]woman[/i][/color]'s job...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Somehow, I don't think this won me any points with Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor... This is $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's $ZOE... The new cheerleading recruit.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You mean the pretty one who baked cookies for everyone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... That was my cousin, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah... You're the `other` one.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah... You're the [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] one.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I could use a wing-woman for a little boy-related mission I'm working on.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you can be at the mall in three minutes, the spot is yours.
Two minutes and fifty-eight seconds later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't pant like that. It's unattractive.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now... Where's my target?
$ZOE and Taylor spot a tall, very cute guy across the food court.

nodes.speaker: Taylor

nodes.text: It would be nice if you'd let me practice my tutoring skills. So I don't get rusty, you know?

And an hour later...

nodes.text_bbcode: ...So the angles [color=#3b78e2][i]must[/i][/color] add up to 360 degrees!

nodes.text: Well... I think I can take it from here.

nodes.text: And... Uh... Thanks.

nodes.text: Sure thing.

nodes.text: But don't think this means I'm going to take it easy on you at tryouts. That spot is still going to be mine.

$ZOE runs back to her room and closes the door. Puddles crawls out from under her bed.

nodes.text: But how am I supposed to be nice to Sam when she's constantly picking fights with me?!

nodes.text: I'm just not sure if losing her cheerleading spot to you is going to help matters.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy

nodes.text_bbcode: Sam just wants [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] badly to be a winner...

At lunch...

nodes.text: Don't listen to him! He's just spreading rumors so that he can impeach our rightfully-elected leader and take his spot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... It's just... I guess I'm usually more of an up-in-the-bleachers kind of girl. Sam's always been the one who wants to be in the spotlight.

nodes.text: You might not believe this, but last year, I spent the whole season in my best friend's shadow.

nodes.text: Aw, Howard makes me feel really good about myself...

nodes.text: Well, this has been fun, but if I'm late to football practice again, Coach is going to kill me... So I'd better take you home.
